richness_list: Full polynomial Bogolyubov conjecture: 4A contains a subspace of size K^{-C}|A|
Quasi-polynomial improvements to the exponent in Bogolyubov–Ruzsa-type lemmas, i.e. K^{-O(log^2 K)}
Better bounds for the inverse theorem for the Gowers U^3 norm in F_2^n
Better bounds for the Freiman–Ruzsa theorem in F_2^n beyond polynomial Freiman–Ruzsa-type covering results
Improved bounds for Roth-type / 3-AP problems in F_2^n via almost-periodicity
Stronger structure results for sets with small doubling, such as large subspaces inside 2A-2A with fewer sumset iterations
Improved bounds for approximate homomorphisms and for the linearity-testing/Gowers U^3 inverse problems

Dense Bogolyubov lemma: if $A\subseteq\mathbb F_2^n$ has density $\alpha$, then $2A-2A$ contains a subspace of codimension $O(\log^3(1/\alpha))$, improving Sanders' $O(\log^4(1/\alpha))$; this is the special case $K\le 1/\alpha$.

Linearization of approximate homomorphisms: an improved bound on the codimension of the subspace on which a map $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2^m$ with many additive quadruples agrees with an affine map (equivalently, an improved subspace-restricted form of the Freiman-homomorphism statement).

Quantitative improvements for inverse theorems and related regularity arguments that use a Bogolyubov step on a large subspace, such as the $U^3$ and $U^4$ inverse theorems over $\mathbb F_2^n$ when structure is required on a subspace of small codimension.

Improved subspace-finding bounds in applications of Bogolyubov–Ruzsa to communication complexity and Boolean function analysis, for example parity decision tree depth and XOR-function protocols for functions of small spectral norm or low approximate structure.
Optimal dependence on the exponent m in polynomial Freiman–Ruzsa-type covering theorems for bounded-torsion groups
Sharp polynomial bounds in Freiman–Ruzsa for groups Z/mZ^n with explicit exponent in m
Whether intervals in Z/pZ are extremal: determine whether C(p) = Theta(log p)
Improved quantitative Bogolyubov–Ruzsa lemma in bounded exponent groups with polynomial dependence on m
Analogous covering by a subgroup of size at most |A| for general abelian groups via generalized arithmetic progressions with improved dimension bounds
Determine the asymptotic behavior of C(m) for composite m versus prime m
Improved dependence on $m$ in the weak PFR statement for $m$-torsion groups: every $A$ with $|A+A|\le K|A|$ has a subset $A'$ with $|A'|\ge(2K)^{-O(C(m))}|A|$ and $\dim A'=O(C(m)\log(2K))$.

Polynomial inverse $U^3$ theorem on $(\mathbb Z/m\mathbb Z)^n$ with correlation bounds whose exponent has the improved dependence on $m$, for $m$ in the range where the known reduction from PFR applies.

Approximate homomorphisms: a map $f:G\to G'$ between $m$-torsion groups with at least $|G|^3/K$ additive quadruples agrees with an affine-linear map on a set of density $(2K)^{-O(C(m))}$, for $m$ in the range where the Balog-Szemerédi-Gowers reduction applies.

Structure of sets with small doubling in $(\mathbb Z/p\mathbb Z)^n$ with $p$ growing with $K$: for $p=K^{O(1)}$, an $O(\log m)$ bound would give covering by $\exp(O(\log^2 K))$ translates, uniformly in $n$.

Quantitative Freiman theorem for sets of small doubling in torsion-free groups, heuristically via Freiman-isomorphic models in $(\mathbb Z/m\mathbb Z)^d$ with $m=K^{O(1)}$, giving quasi-polynomial covering bounds if the dimension can be controlled.
Determination of the correct order of $C(m)$ up to constants, matching the interval lower bound $\log_4((p+1)/2)$ for primes $p$.
Improved bounds for the torsion-dependent entropic form of PFR: for $m$-torsion-valued $X,Y$, there is a subgroup $H$ with $d[X;U_H]+d[Y;U_H]\le C'(m)\,d[X;Y]$ with $C'(m)$ subpolynomial in $m$.
Determine whether lim_{p→∞} γ_p exists, and its value.
Improve the upper bound constant 0.841 for the cap-set-type 3-AP problem in F_p^n for large p.
Better asymptotic lower bounds on r_3(F_p^n) via new constructions (e.g., Elsholtz–Pach style), giving explicit exponential growth rates.
Analogous questions for k-term progressions in F_p^n (k≥4) and the limit of the normalized growth rate.
Relate γ_p to slice-rank / symmetric tensor rank asymptotics, e.g., the asymptotic subrank of the tensor for x+y=2z.
Determine the exact value of γ_3 (cap set constant) or γ_5 and whether constructions beat known lower bounds.
Understand behavior of Behrend-type constructions in F_p^n versus Z/NZ and the sharpness of the Ellenberg–Gijswijt method for large p.
Improved exponential lower bounds for $r_3(\mathbb Z_m^n)$ when $m$ is composite with all prime factors large, using the product construction over the coprime factors of $m$.

Determining whether $\lim_{p\to\infty}\gamma_p=0.841\ldots$ would settle whether the slice-rank upper bound is asymptotically tight for 3-AP-free sets as $p\to\infty$, and hence whether their growth rate matches that of tricolored sum-free sets.
A construction with $\gamma_p\ge 0.6$ would likely give corresponding constants for sets avoiding solutions to other three-variable equations $ax+by+cz=0$ with $a+b+c=0$ in $\mathbb F_p^n$.
A new construction beating $0.54$, if its digits lie in a short interval, could give further improvements to the constant in Behrend-type lower bounds for $r_3([N])$ in the integers.
Determine the exact value of c_infty = liminf L_p, or improve its known lower bound.
Whether L_p tends to 1 or to a constant strictly below 1 as p grows (asymptotics of the cap-set growth rate in F_p^n).
Improved Behrend-type lower bounds for r_3(N) obtained from improved constructions in F_p^n for large p.
Analogous transference for k-term progressions or for other linear equations over F_p^n versus integers.
Prove that the sequence L_p is monotone or has a limit, for example by relating L_p to L_q for p<q.

A positive answer to (b) would convert any finite-field construction with $c_\infty>1/2$ into a bound $C_*\le 2\sqrt{2\log_2(1/c_\infty)}$. This removes the loss in the naive digit embedding, whose exponent is $2\sqrt{1+\log_2(1/c)}$, and would improve the Elsholtz–Hunter–Proske–Sauermann constant if their finite-field density constant applies.
Comparison of $L_p$ and $L_{p'}$ for nearby primes $p,p'$: approximate monotonicity or continuity in $p$, as a route to or consequence of the limit in (a).
Identification of $\lim_p L_p$ with a continuous quantity, such as a tensor-power density of 3-AP-free subsets of the torus $(\mathbb R/\mathbb Z)^n$ or a measure-theoretic analogue.
Whether the finite-field and integer versions are asymptotically equivalent: a transfer in the converse direction, from Behrend-type lower bounds in $[N]$ to lower bounds for $c_\infty$.
Analogous transfer statements for other translation-invariant equations, such as $k$-AP-free sets or $x+y+z=3w$-type equations in $\mathbb F_p^n$ versus $[N]$.
Analogue of (a) for the corner-free or Ruzsa–Szemerédi-type constants derived from 3-AP-free sets, including the corresponding improvements to Behrend-based graph constructions.
